title: AI Ethics Arcade
intro: Be a responsible AI hero! Test your ethics know-how. First-try wins earn ⭐⭐⭐.

options: The AI is unfair, often from unfair data
The AI uses too much battery
rounds.explain: Bias means the AI treats some groups unfairly, usually because of unbalanced training data.

options: A fake image or video made by AI that looks real
rounds.explain: Deepfakes are AI-generated images or videos designed to look real.

rounds.prompt: Match each concern to its description.
rounds.explain: Privacy, misinformation, and bias are key things to watch for when using AI.

rounds.prompt: Which is a responsible way to use AI?
options: Double-check answers and protect private info
rounds.explain: Responsible users verify answers, protect privacy, and never use AI to harm others.

options: Yes — it can be confidently wrong
rounds.explain: AI can sound very sure and still be wrong, so always think critically and check.
